name: omnibridge/eloquent
description: omnibase's persistence on Eloquent's database layer, framework-free: illuminate/database (Laravel's connection, or Capsule outside Laravel) reading the tables omnisense/omnibridge's schema describes into the same plain PHP entities any other persistence maps - a data mapper: tables from the description, a hydrator with PHP 8.4 lazy ghosts and lazy collections, an identity map, casts; behind the core's contracts, the compiler of the finder language, the statements of the backend-only queries, the unit of work and its lifecycle. It declares no repository: Base\Repository\* are the core's, the same on every persistence.

suggest.omnisense/omnibase: The core this package is the Eloquent persistence of (^1.0)
